prerequisites: TEORÍA DE ESTRUCTURAS Y CONSTRUCCIONES INDUSTRIALES

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding of the engineering disciplines specific to their specialty, at the necessary level to acquire the rest of the degree's competencies, including notions of the latest advances.
Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

The ability to analyze complex products, processes, and systems in their field of study; choose and apply relevant established analytical, computational, and experimental methods and correctly interpret the results of such analyses.

The ability to identify, formulate, and solve engineering problems in their specialty; choose and apply appropriate established analytical, computational, and experimental methods; recognize the importance of social, health and safety, environmental, economic, and industrial constraints.

Ability to perform bibliographic searches, consult, and critically use databases and other information sources, to carry out simulation and analysis with the aim of conducting research on technical topics in their specialty.
Ability to consult and apply good practice and safety codes in their specialty.
Ability and skill to design and carry out experimental investigations, interpret results, and draw conclusions in their field of study.
Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, design, and research and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects, and conduct research specific to their specialty.
Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment, and tools, technology and engineering processes, and their limitations in their specialty.
Ability to apply engineering practice standards in their specialty.
Ability to collect and interpret data and handle complex concepts within their specialty, to make judgments that involve reflection on ethical and social issues.
Ability to manage complex technical or professional activities or projects in their specialty, taking responsibility for decision-making.
Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with both engineers and people from other disciplines.
Ability to stay up-to-date with developments in science and technology.
Knows the fundamentals of the finite element method.
Models real systems considering the objective of the analysis.
Is able to solve and analyze mechanical problems using specific software.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of finite elements and programming
Static-linear calculations and modeling using SolidWorks Simulation software
Advanced calculations using SolidWorks Simulation software
teaching_methods: Teacher presentation in class, in participatory classes, of concepts and procedures associated with the subjects
Computer simulation practices, individually and/or in teams
Development, drafting, and presentation of reports, memos, audiovisual material, etc. related to projects/POPBLs

assessment_methods.method: Individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject
Reports on exercises, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, and laboratory practices

assessment_rules: Individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject can be recovered. Reports on exercises, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, and laboratory practices can be recovered. Feedback on work is provided for certain components.
